verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents per-request parameters such as render_js, premium_proxy, extract_rules and js_scenario, and its CLI offers a crawl command. Nothing in the evidence shows a batch job that maps different crawl configurations to different URL patterns. Sending each request with its own parameters is a user-side workaround, not the batch per-pattern configuration this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can apply different crawl configurations to different URL patterns within a single batch job
